facts.text: Tsukiji Outer Market has around 60 shops, and many serve fresh sushi for breakfast.
The wholesale fish market moved from Tsukiji to Toyosu in 2018; the outer market stayed.
Senso-ji in Asakusa is Tokyo's oldest Buddhist temple, with Nakamise Street nearby.

scenarios.situation: You just landed. It is early and you are starving.
scenarios.prompt: I am hungry near Tsukiji. Suggest a sushi breakfast and tell me what to order if I cannot read the menu.

scenarios.situation: You want one good photo route for Instagram.
scenarios.prompt: Plan a 3 hour walking route in Asakusa with the best photo spots and the best time of day for each.

facts.text: Fushimi Inari shrine is free to enter and open around the clock.
The lower torii tunnels are busiest; the upper trails are quieter, so go early or late.

scenarios.situation: Everyone says the gates are crowded. You want a clear photo.
scenarios.prompt: I want photos of the torii gates without crowds. Plan my morning, and tell me how long the hike takes.

facts.text: Hiroshima okonomiyaki is built in layers on a thin batter, not mixed together like Osaka style.
You choose soba or udon noodles when you order, for example niku-tama-soba.
Okonomimura is a four-story building of okonomiyaki stalls at 5-13 Shintenchi, Naka Ward.

scenarios.situation: The menu is in Japanese and the cook is waiting.
scenarios.prompt: Explain Hiroshima okonomiyaki and how to order it, including the noodle choice, in simple words.

cities.name: Fukuoka
cities.backdrop: Yatai food stalls along the Naka River

facts.text: The yatai stalls open from early evening until late at night.
Hakata-style ramen is known for its tonkotsu (pork bone) broth, and is popular at Fukuoka's yatai stalls.
No reservations are needed at the yatai stalls, and payment is usually cash.

scenarios.situation: It is 9 PM and you want a real local dinner.
scenarios.prompt: Where do I eat dinner like a local in Fukuoka tonight, and how do I order at a yatai stall?

cities.name: Sapporo
cities.backdrop: Snowy city, ramen alley at night

facts.text: Miso ramen began in Sapporo after World War II; the official tourism site dates it to 1958.
The broth is seasoned with red miso, and the wavy noodles were made to hold it.

scenarios.situation: It is freezing and you want the dish this city invented.
scenarios.prompt: I just arrived in Sapporo and it is cold. What is miso ramen, and what should I order first?
